title: game changer
body: I’ve been using Focus Bear for a while now and it’s really helped me stay organized and motivated to do healthy habits as well as complete assignments/work that i’ve been dreading to do. One feature that’s been most impactful (although there are many that I really appreciate) is the customizable blocking. This tool allows me to choose the apps/websites I want to block whenever I start a focus session or when I intend to go to bed. It lets me choose what mode of block I want; the strict or the easy mode. It’s honestly stopped so many nights of doomscrolling (my sleep schedule really appreciates it). Although this review is getting a bit long the highlight of the whole app is the focus session which sets a time for me to work and then gives me a break (with cute bear avatars that suggest the time interval at which I study that is most optimized, the Pomodoro technique for example). This isn’t related to the app but they also have a desktop version for your computer which combined with the mobile app is just chef’s kiss. One last mention is their support team. Honestly, never have I used an app or website where i’ve felt so heard as a user, it’s very easy to reach out to the team with requests for new features or feedback on their existing ones with suggestions for improvement. Overall 10/10, if I could give more stars I would.

title: Focus Bear
body: I absolutely love the Focus Bear app! 🐻💛 It helps me stay focused, productive, and calm throughout the day. I really like how it reminds me to take little breaks and move around — it feels like having a friendly coach who wants the best for you. The design is cute and positive, and it honestly makes working or studying so much easier and more enjoyable. Big thanks to the Focus Bear team for creating something that truly helps people stay on track and take care of themselves at the same time! 💪✨
